Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

American football noun

also gridiron, football (American), fullback, halfback, quarterback, tackle (player), touchdown, extra point, punt, make a touchdown

modern

M-O s.v. football: rugby: American football

harpastum Americānum

Classically harpastum is a small hard ball and the rough game played with it, in which the players snatched the ball from one another (Mart. 4.19.6, 7.67.4).

Other words

  • harpastum, harpastī n. — American football; the ball

    noun, second declension · also used · modern · Andresian pp. 18–19

    Andresian’s name for the American game and its ball; Traupman keeps it for rugby (see rugby).

  • pedifollium mōre Americānō

    also used · modern · Traupman 47

    Traupman’s “football in the American way”, with a list of its terms (touchdown, quarterback).
